register_config_source: register a ConfigSource subclass with the SourcesRegistry singleton using its scheme
resolve_config_source: resolve a ConfigSource type from the registry by its scheme string
get_sources_registry_instance: get the singleton instance of SourcesRegistry via the instance static method
review_sources_registry: review the SourcesRegistry class and its register and resolve methods for config source management
refactor_sources_registry: refactor the SourcesRegistry to support additional validation or logging on register and resolve
